title: Kioskeria: Summer Breeze!
description:
Welcome to Asteria!

Serve diverse cast of customers, in a sunny beach, night city, or the park. Sometimes the customers are in the mood for refreshing drinks and sometimes for waffles. Look out for the busy rush hour, where customers are plenty! In order to maximize profits, plan your menu around it. If you nail the orders, you get more money!

Use the hard earned money you earned to upgrade your kiosk. Buy parts for a fancier appearance, buy new stations to expand your menu, candy dispensers, or charms, which can help you deliver food faster!

 

Use your grill, fryer, ingredient station, cutting station, and much more, to cook your foods. 

You can visit old Old Pa who you inherited his beloved kiosk business with a letter that you can only open when you kiosk has reached a 5-star status. Please visit whenever the doctors allow!
description_short: Run and manage your own cooking kiosk business. Serve customers, earn money, buy new equipment, and expand your menu. Customize your kiosk, design your own menu, and choose your location, whether on the beach, in the city, or in a park. Can you reach 5-star status? No generative AI used.
